curve_or_factor_stream_accepted: all attempts before accepted_attempt are rejected
optimizer_or_verifier_cell: no retry is permitted for any reason

children.inputs: one accepted curve and one registered factor-base seed
one accepted factor base and one chart scalar
one chart fixture and one of 32 compilers
one compiler packet and one of four caps
one optimizer cell plus immutable parents
children.work: deterministic replay and independent primary proof in one fresh process with disjoint caches

canonical_process_dag.spawn_rule: Every listed child is a direct posix_spawn+exec child of the future supervisor.

development_invocations.fixture: two cell requests in one input

development_invocations.expected: exception after nonzero observed work; full reserved charge
timeout after nonzero observed work; full reserved charge
success with fsync and exclusive rename
publication_failure after forced write or fsync error

development_rule.rerun: Any rerun requires a new reviewed development manifest and does not reuse an ID.

abnormal_charge.cpu_and_disk: report wait4/proc_pid_rusage observations and separately charge the full per-attempt frozen ceilings
abnormal_charge.memory: report sampled and kernel observations and separately charge hard_rss_limit_bytes
abnormal_charge.operations: report last durable lower bound and separately charge every frozen operation ceiling for the attempt
abnormal_charge.optimizer_nodes: report last durable lower bound and separately charge node_cap
abnormal_charge.storage: report observed allocated bytes and separately charge the per-attempt storage ceiling
abnormal_charge.wall: report observed elapsed time and separately charge hard_wall_limit_ns

failure_telemetry.acknowledgement: Supervisor creates a second pre-opened pipe. The child may leave a named phase only after reading one byte acknowledging the fsynced snapshot.
failure_telemetry.child_frames: After each named phase and every 1024 optimizer nodes, child writes one U32BE-length-prefixed canonical JSON counter snapshot to a pre-opened pipe.
failure_telemetry.completion: A successful child emits a final complete=true frame whose counters equal its artifact counters.
failure_telemetry.parent_durability: The supervisor validates monotonic snapshots, appends each to attempt-ledger.jsonl, flushes, and fsyncs before acknowledging the next phase.
failure_telemetry.publication_failure: Core artifact and telemetry counters remain charged even when final exclusive publication fails.
failure_telemetry.signal_or_timeout: Supervisor records wait status and the last fsynced lower bound; no missing work is reported as zero.

io_and_storage.disk_io: macOS proc_pid_rusage RUSAGE_INFO_V4 ri_diskio_bytesread and ri_diskio_byteswritten, in bytes, sampled by the parent before wait/reap; unavailable measurement fails closed
io_and_storage.hard_link_rule: logical artifacts remain separate; physical totals deduplicate equal (st_dev,st_ino)
io_and_storage.rss: wait4 ru_maxrss interpreted as bytes on frozen macOS; parent also samples proc_pid_rusage physical footprint at 10ms intervals; platform and units are mandatory
io_and_storage.storage_budget_equation: peak_live_temporary_allocated_bytes + final_retained_allocated_bytes <= 67108864 for the complete D01..D13 campaign

optimizer_equations.nodes_pruned_conflict: always 0 for the pinned optimizer; conflict_vertices_removed counts vertices removed from include-branch availability
optimizer_equations.remaining_frontier_digest: SHA256(canonical JSON frontier list), empty value 4f53cda18c2baa0c0354bb5f9a3ecbe5ed12ab4d8e11ba873c2f11161202b945

operation_ceiling.rule: Every non-resource work counter is checked before increment; reaching its ceiling stops with resource_limit. An abnormally terminated child is charged this ceiling for each work counter except optimizer nodes, which are charged node_cap.
